clips.title: The story
paras: Dark sorcery stirs within the Tower of Althalaxx on northern Darkshore's coast. Once Athrikus Narassin's retreat, the ancient Highborne spire now shelters demonic cultists and warlocks.

Queen Azshara settled favored Highborne servants in Ameth'Aran and Bashal'Aran ten thousand years ago, placing the powerful sorcerer Athrikus Narassin in authority over them. As he grew distant from civic governance, Athrikus chose to isolate himself in the nearby Tower of Althalaxx. The Great Sundering shattered ancient Kalimdor, but the tower endured on Darkshore's desolate coastline, a quiet ruin of forgotten elven magic.
